notes: The cookie restarts at 90 days on every fresh click.

name: UpCloud
notes: The page says $10 at trial signup, $20 or $50 at first payment (it states both), and $100 once the customer spends $150 within six months, totaling $130 in one place and $160 in another. It also says affiliates can 'earn recurring revenue' while listing only those three rewards. European visitors see €10, €20, €100 and €130.

name: UpdraftPlus
commission: 30% revenue share on every sale
notes: The program is run at TeamUpdraft, the parent brand, and covers its whole plugin range rather than UpdraftPlus alone.

name: UpLead
commission: 20% on all paid plans
notes: The page states the 60-day cookie is a default UpLead reserves the right to change, and tells affiliates to contact them to confirm it — unusual candour worth noting.

name: UptimeRobot
commission: 20% of each monthly or annual payment
notes: Attribution happens at registration, not at purchase — if the account was created without your link, a later subscription through it earns nothing.

name: Usercentrics
commission: 40%, dropping to 20%
notes: 40% for a Standard Partner's first three years or an Elite Partner's first five, then 20%, paid for as long as the referral's subscription stays active.

name: UserGuiding
commission: $250 gift card per qualified discovery call, plus 10% of first-year deal value
notes: The 10% covers the first year of the deal and is paid separately after the deal closes; the page does not say whether renewals earn.

name: Usermaven
commission: 30% recurring
notes: Commissions release 45 days after the month of the sale. The 14-day cookie is among the shortest here.

name: Userpilot
commission: $500 per qualified opportunity
notes: Paid on qualification, not on the sale.

name: ValuEdge
commission: 40% of eligible subscription payments
notes: Commission continues while the referred subscription stays active.

name: Vecteezy
notes: For each new Vecteezy Pro subscriber. Free to join, no minimum sales, paid monthly.

name: VEED
commission: 20% on the initial sale plus 20% recurring, with bonuses up to 50%
notes: Commission sits as pending through a validation period before it clears. Duration of the recurring share is not stated.

name: Visme
commission: 25% of every transaction
notes: The $150 threshold is a monthly bar — you are paid in each month you clear it.

name: Vitals
notes: Tiered 10% / 20% / 25% by monthly referrals; the tier resets each month but the rate a store was won at is kept for its life. Paid on the net after Shopify's cut, between the 15th and 20th.

name: Vizard
notes: Vizard's product is a paid subscription, but the page describes the commission only as 25% of the paid subscription amount per successful referral, without stating whether it recurs on renewal months. Further terms read from the vendor's linked page https://vizard.ai/affliate-program-agreement.html on 2026-09-29.

name: VoiceFleet
commission: 20% of eligible base subscription revenue
notes: Join by invitation; terms are agreed before your link is activated. Monthly payouts after a 30-day hold, less actual payout fees.

name: Vtiger
commission: 15% of monthly recurring revenue
notes: The referral must stay a paying customer for at least 90 days. Only the first product they buy earns commission; later purchases of other products do not. An invoice must be submitted to withdraw.

name: VWO
notes: The page states the rate two ways: '10% commission' in three places, and 'Earn 15% (or more) in affiliate fee' in a fourth.

name: Wapio
notes: Payouts are arranged manually with each affiliate.

name: Wave.video
notes: The page calls the commission recurring but does not say for how long.

name: Web Scraping API
commission: Up to 30% recurring, up to $3,000 per client
notes: Runs for as long as the referred customer stays.

name: Web Ventures
commission: $25 to $100 one-time
notes: One-time commission by the service the customer picks, plus one-time add-on bonuses of $10 to $50. Paid after a 30-day hold; a W-9 is required.

name: WebinarJam
commission: Up to 40%
notes: The FAQ states plainly that lifetime commissions are not offered.

name: Webnode
commission: $100 for a referral's first yearly Premium Plan purchase
notes: Attribution does not expire: the page says referred users are yours for life and a first yearly purchase pays no matter when it happens. Renewals and domain registrations pay nothing. Tracking uses cookies plus IP address.

name: Webshare
commission: 50% of new sales plus 10% recurring
notes: The referred customer must stay in good standing for 30 days before the commission counts. Weekly payouts are unusual here — most programs pay monthly.

name: Whatagraph
commission: 25% across all pricing tiers
notes: Capped at €2,000 per referral. Referrals get 50% off their first month. Paid within 7 business days of the referral becoming a paying customer.

name: Wisepops
notes: Tracked through a Stripe integration; the page is aimed at agencies.

name: Wix
notes: The public page states no commission, window, threshold or payout method — it describes the program and sends applicants to Impact.

name: Wondershare
commission: Up to 50%

name: WooCommerce
commission: Up to 30% on a first purchase, 10% on returning customers
notes: Run as part of the Automattic Affiliate Program.

name: Woodpecker
commission: 20% of every payment
notes: Last-click attribution. The page states the rate is fixed and will not change. Referrals get an extended trial.

name: Workstream
commission: $300 per referred customer that signs
notes: Paid as a gift card. The referred company also receives $300.

name: WorldEye
commission: 15–30% by rank
notes: Three levels: you also earn overrides on sales by affiliates you recruit (+5%) and by their recruits (+2%). Commissions are held 30 days.

name: WP Engine
commission: $100 on Lite plans; on all other plans $200 minimum or the first month's payment, whichever is higher
notes: Paid around the 20th of the month after the referral reaches 62 days and remains in good standing.

name: WP Simple Pay
commission: 20% of the license price
notes: States outright that it does not offer recurring referrals. Paid in USD in the first week of each month, for referrals older than 14 days.

name: WP STAGING
notes: Rate stated two ways: 25% twice and 20% once on the German program page (25% three times on the English page https://wp-staging.com/affiliate-welcome/), while every worked example — $17.80 on an $89 license — is 20%.

name: WPForms
commission: 20% per sale, up to about $59.90 on the Elite license
notes: License prices and the resulting commission are listed per tier: $7.90 Basic to $59.90 Elite.

name: WPvivid
commission: 50% of whatever plan the referral buys
notes: The page contradicts itself on renewals: the banner calls it a recurring commission, while the FAQ says a renewal only pays if the customer clicks the affiliate link again. Paid on the 20th for referrals older than 30 days.

name: WPX
commission: $70, $85 or $100 per sale by volume
notes: Monthly volume bonuses of $500, $1,000 and $1,500 on top. One section calls the commissions lifetime while the rate table is strictly per sale, and the page does not reconcile the two.

name: Writecream
commission: 35% recurring monthly commission
notes: Commission continues every month for as long as the referred customer stays subscribed (billed automatically on renewal, not manual). A separate 'Influencer Program' is linked in the site nav with its own, unfetched terms.

name: WriterZen
notes: Lifetime deals only. Rises to 25% at 100 sales a month and 30% at 300, each sustained for three consecutive months.

name: Writesonic
commission: 20% of every payment
notes: Last-click attribution. Paid monthly on the 1st.

name: Xero
notes: States that the rate depends on your audience and geography and is discussed only after you apply — the rate is negotiated, not published.

name: YouCanBook.me
commission: $25 in credit for a referral on a 12- or 24-month plan; $4 for a monthly plan
notes: Paid as credit toward your own next subscription or renewal. Referrals get 50% off their first subscription. This is the customer referral program; the site lists a separate affiliate program.

name: zcal
notes: Paid in USD at the end of every month, for as long as the referral stays a customer.

name: Zendesk
commission: 15% for the first year of sales
notes: No floor or ceiling on referrals or earnings. Top affiliates are said to earn more, without the page saying how much.

name: Zendrop
commission: $25 per signup
notes: You do not need to run a store or dropship yourself to join.

name: ZenRows
commission: 35% recurring for 12 months on self-serve; 15% of year-one revenue when a deal is sales-assisted; 40% self-serve once featured
notes: Featured status needs €2,000 of active referred revenue held for three months, and reverts if it drops. Churn inside 60 days of first payment voids the commission and can be recovered from later balances.

name: ZeroBounce
commission: 18% of gross sales for the first 12 months, then 5% for the life of the customer
payoutMethod: Cash or ZeroBounce credits, 35 days after the sale is final
notes: One of the few programs that publishes what happens after year one instead of stopping at the headline rate.

name: zipBoard
notes: Of the revenue from every new customer referred.

name: Zoho
commission: 15%, 18% or 20% by tier, plus an additional 5% one-time bonus on deals of $5,000, $10,000 or $15,000 invoice value by tier
notes: Tiers are set by revenue (new plus upgrade) of up to $5,000, $5,001–$15,000 and $15,001+, or by up to 20, 21–50 and 51+ new paid customers. Commission on a single deal is capped at $25,000. The FAQ answers 'Will I earn recurring commissions?' with 'No', and limits commission to revenue in the first 12 months.

name: Zonka Feedback
notes: A $10 bonus for each new paid customer referred in your first 30 days.

name: Zyte
notes: Capped at $2,000 per client. Paid monthly on the 15th.
